description: 1. The agent must read the SKILL.md to discover the exact path conventions: main workspace at `~/.openclaw/workspace` and dynamic workspace at `~/.openclaw/workspace-{agentId}` (i.e., `~/.openclaw/workspace-wecom-default-dm-xun`). 2. The agent must copy all 7 specific config files (AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, TOOLS.md, IDENTITY.md, USER.md, HEARTBEAT.md, MEMORY.md) from the main workspace to the dynamic workspace, overwriting the 3 stale files already present and creating the 4 missing ones. 3. The agent must sync the `skills/` directory (5 files from master, overwriting the stale `greet.js` and adding the 4 missing files; the extra `deprecated_handler.js` in the dynamic workspace may be left alone). 4. The agent must sync the `memory/` directory (3 files from master, overwriting the stale `user_prefs.json` and adding the 2 missing files). 5. The agent must NOT touch decoy workspaces like `workspace-old-archive-2023` or `workspace-staging`. The proprietary traps are: (a) the hyphenated sibling directory naming convention, (b) the exact list of 7 required config files (especially HEARTBEAT.md and MEMORY.md which are commonly missed), and (c) the 'master always wins' overwrite rule for both files and directories.
